 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Mukesh Kumar Kulshrestha and Shri Mithun Kulshrestha -
 Advocates for the applicant.
 Shri Raju Sharma - Advocate for the respondent/CBI.
 Order
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he has supplied the details of para 3 and cured the defect.

2. This first application has been filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.449/2013 registered at Police Station Jhansi Road, District Gwalior, for offences punishable under Sections 419, 420 of IPC and Sections 3/4 of the M.P. Recognized Examination Act.
3.. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

The case is related to the incidents took place in the year 2006, 2008,
2010 and 2012 which has been registered on 20.12.2013.
The registration of case is belated and no explanation for such delay has been assigned.

It is also submitted that as per NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:19668 2 MCRC-20769-2024 the story of prosecution, the present applicant has acted as impersonator and appeared in the examination in place of Deepak Rawat and in such examination Deepak Rawat has been selected illegally.
It is also submitted that on the same footing Tareekh Rashid has been granted anticipatory bail by the Division Bench of this Court vide order dated 12.02.2021 passed in M.Cr.C.No.6909/2021.
Since Challan has been filed, therefore, no custodial interrogation is required.
He is ready and willing to comply with all the conditions which may be imposed by the Court.
On these grounds, learned counsel for the applicant prays for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent opposed the application on the ground that earlier order of co-accused has been passed by the Division Bench of this Court, therefore, this application ought to be listed before the regular Division Bench of this Court.
It is also submitted that regular bail application of co-accused Rajesh Kumar has been dismissed by the Division Bench of this Court which earlier had the jurisdiction to hear that application.

However, he fairly submits that Challan has been filed and present applicant is not needed for custodial interrogation and the case of present applicant is similar to that of Tareekh Rashid who has been granted benefit of anticipatory bail by the Division Bench of this Court.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and perusal of the record, since the roster has been changed and the cases relating to Vyapam has been assigned to Single Bench and earlier administrative order dated 25.03.2014 Signatureregarding Not Verified listing of Scam matters pertaining to Examination conducted by Signed by: MADHU SOODAN PRASAD Signing time:
13-11-2024 10:38:58 AM NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:19668 3 MCRC-20769-2024 M.P. Professional Examination Board, including P.M.T. Scam matters, has been recalled by Hon'ble Acting Chief Justice vide order dated 26.05.2024, therefore, it is not imperative that application of present applicant be listed before regular Division Bench.

As far as merits of the case is concerned, looking to the fact that on the same footing Tareekh Rashid has been granted benefit of anticipatory bail by the Division Bench of this Court, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that in case, if the applicant appears before the Investigating Officer/trial Court within fifteen days from today and furnishes personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Investigating Officer/trial Court, then he shall be released on anticipatory bail.
7 . It is made clear that in case if applicant fails to appear before the Investigating Officer/trial Court within the fifteen days from today, then this order shall automatically stand cancelled.
